name: @pipeworx/mcp-metals-api

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Get the latest precious and base metal spot prices (gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper, etc.). Prices are per troy ounce. Optionally specify base currency and metal symbols.

symbols.description: Comma-separated metal symbols to filter (e.g., "XAU,XAG,XPT"). XAU=gold, XAG=silver, XPT=platinum, XPD=palladium, XCU=copper

tools.name: get_historical
tools.description: Get metal prices for a specific historical date. Returns spot prices per troy ounce for that day. Useful for tracking price changes or computing returns.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-metals-api forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the metals-api pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
